verdict.rationale: Bench is a done-for-you bookkeeping service where a human bookkeeper manages the books; the evidence pack shows no self-serve chart-of-accounts customization, account types, sub-accounts, or class/tag dimension configuration exposed to the accountant/customer. The client-facing surface is reports and downloads, not ledger/CoA editing. Missing for 10: any mention of CoA management, account type/sub-account creation, or class/tag dimension tagging capability.
